Metric hex head bolt (ISO 4014) with hex.family: ISO 4014/4032 standard (non heavy-hex) metric series, ISO 7089 plain washer
Metric hex head bolt (ISO 4014) with hex.source: Listed FIRST deliberately: server/build.ts's loadBoltDims() takes the FIRST family seen per diameter, so this standard series is the DEFAULT bolt glyph unless a connection's own assembly is later marked HR/HV (preloaded structural, EN 14399), which should prefer the heavier series below instead. For M16 the two series differ visibly: ISO 4014 across-flats 24 / across-corners 27.71 (= 24 / cos30) vs EN 14399 heavy-hex 27 / 31.18. Across-flats (s) per ISO 4014 standard series; across-corners e = s / cos(30deg) = s * 2/sqrt(3). Head height (k), nut thickness (m, ISO 4032 style 1), washer thickness (ISO 7089) and EN 1090-2 normal-round-hole clearance are IDENTICAL between the standard and heavy-hex series (only across-flats/corners differs), so those four columns are carried over unchanged from the verified heavy-hex table below.

Metric hex head bolt (ISO 4014/4017) wit.family: Metric structural hex bolt/nut per EN 14399-3(HR)/-4(HV) with ISO 7089 washer (EN 1090-2)
Metric hex head bolt (ISO 4014/4017) wit.source: Primary: ISO 4014/4017 (hex bolt s/e/k), ISO 4032 (nut thickness m, max), ISO 7089 (200 HV plain washer thickness), EN 1090-2 Table 11 (nominal clearance, normal round hole). Second independent cross-check: fasteners.eu (ISO 4014 hex bolt & ISO 4032 nut tables), amesweb.info metric hex nut chart, and engineeringhardware.com ISO 4014 hex bolt table. All s/e/k/m/washer/hole values verified against the second source; bolt-head e (across corners) confirmed as ISO 4014 values (M20 33.53, M24 39.98), distinct from the smaller ISO 4032 nut e-min (32.95/39.55). No corrections required. | across-flats corrected to EN 14399 structural (s: M20=32 confirmed vs drawing; e=s*2/√3).

ASTM F3125 (A325/A490) Heavy Hex Structu.family: ASTM F3125 (A325/A490) Heavy Hex Structural Bolt, ASME B18.2.6
ASTM F3125 (A325/A490) Heavy Hex Structu.source: Original values from ASME B18.2.6 (heavy hex structural bolts) with heavy hex nut thickness per ASME B18.2.2, and std_hole per AISC Steel Construction Manual Table J3.3 (d+1/16 in for d<=7/8 in, d+1/8 in for d>=1 in); nominal inch values converted at 25.4 mm/in. Independently cross-checked against Atlanta Rod & Manufacturing heavy hex bolt and heavy hex nut dimension charts (atlrod.com) and the Birmingham Fastener F3125 A325/A490 heavy hex dimension chart (bhamfast.com). All values confirmed; the 7/8 in width across flats is 1-7/16 in (36.513 mm) per Atlanta Rod and the 1.5d+1/8 heavy-hex rule (Birmingham Fastener's 1-9/16 in was a source error and was not adopted).
